hints.title: Expanded State Structural Analysis
hints.text: Track the shortest distance to each node using a state that indicates whether the free edge discount has already been used.

hints.title: Two State Levels
hints.text: For each node u, maintain dist[u][0] (no edge discounted yet) and dist[u][1] (one edge discounted).

hints.title: Priority Queue Relaxation
hints.text: From state (d, u, 0), relax neighbor v with weight w to (d + w, v, 0) or to (d, v, 1) by waiving weight w.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here V is the number of vertices and E is the number of edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running standard Dijkstra repeatedly while omitting every individual edge takes O(E * (V + E) log V).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Expanding states to V * 2 takes minimal extra space and solves the problem in a single Dijkstra search.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects 2-layered graph representation or stateful Dijkstra.
